edits.headline: Flydubai flight to Tel Aviv diverts to Saudi Arabia after cockpit attack
edits.subheadline: The co-pilot attacked Indian captain Smit Machchhar on flight FZ1073, which landed in Tabuk, Al Jazeera reported.
editorialBody: A co-pilot attacked the captain of flydubai flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv on 30 September, Al Jazeera reported. The plane was diverted and landed in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.

India's embassy in Saudi Arabia named the captain as Smit Machchhar, an Indian national. He was in hospital in a stable condition with several stab wounds, Al Jazeera reported. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said 174 people were on board.
Netanyahu said it was too early to say whether Iran was involved in the attack, BBC News reported.

Tennessee officials could not complete the execution of Christa Pike on 30 September, Al Jazeera reported. Her lawyers said she was given two doses of pentobarbital and was taken to hospital in critical condition. Governor Bill Lee ordered a third-party review.
A review found that Travelodge failed a sexual assault victim "at every stage", BBC News reported.
Crypto platforms lost $1.26bn to hacks in the third quarter of 2026, CoinDesk reported, citing data from the security firm CertiK. Bitcoin rose about 40% over the same quarter.
SpaceX was set to launch Google AI chips into orbit with Planet Labs satellites as a test of space-based data centres, CNBC reported.
